title: A Spectral-based ISS small-gain theorem for boundary control systems with infinite couplings
summary: We study the input-to-state stability (ISS) of boundary control systems allowing for infinitely many boundary couplings. Using semigroup perturbation theory and the theory of positive linear operators on Banach lattices, we derive a spectral small-gain condition ensuring exponential ISS. We further investigate linear Boltzmann-type equations on an infinite network of intersecting circles, incorporating delays, scattering, and disturbances acting at the junction.
